verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs describe its own webhooks: HTTP push notifications fire whenever data is created, updated or removed. A programmatic consumer registers them via the webhookCreate mutation, scoped to a team or all public teams, and supplies a callback url. The Inbox/Slack event subscription (linear-docs-61) is a chat-style notification, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the supported event/resource types, payload format, signature verification and retry behavior, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.
call the webhookCreate mutation with the teamId (or allPublicTeams: true) and url of your webhook
